description: This file is a Perl module defining package metadata parsing functions, including parsing package and target metadata, handling user and group IDs, and managing internal data structures for package information.

methods.name: get_multiline
methods.description: Reads multiline string from file handle until @@ marker or end of file, optionally prepending a prefix to each line.

methods.name: confstr
methods.description: Transforms a configuration string by replacing certain characters with underscores.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata_usergroup
methods.description: Parses user or group specification strings, validates IDs and names, and updates corresponding hashes.

methods.name: parse_target_metadata
methods.description: Parses target metadata from a file, extracting target properties, profiles, and subtargets.

methods.name: clear_packages
methods.description: Resets internal data structures related to package metadata.

methods.name: parse_package_metadata
methods.description: Parses detailed package metadata from a file, populating internal hashes and data structures.

methods.name: parse_package_manifest_metadata
methods.description: Parses package manifest metadata from a file, extracting package details.
